_doc: Athanor runtime configuration. Project root file. Source of truth for memory/codex/work/team/triggers settings referenced from CLAUDE.md and skills/. User installs may override individual fields; missing fields fall back to these defaults.

codex._doc: Cross-model planning via Codex CLI. enabled=true makes /athanor:plan deep tier dispatch a Codex Planner B in parallel with Claude Planner A. fallback strategy when codex CLI is unavailable: 'self-critic' (Claude self-reviews) | 'skip' (single-planner only) | 'fail' (abort). See skills/plan/SKILL.md §Step 0 codex_available probe.

ralphLoop._doc: Max ralph-loop iterations per subtask before circuit breaker engages. Each iteration re-runs the executor with the same subtask plus latest verify output. Increase for fragile verify commands; decrease for fast-fail policy.

circuitBreaker._doc: After N consecutive subtask failures, leader pauses and asks user: action options are 'ask_user' (default), 'continue' (next subtask), 'abort' (stop pipeline).

team._doc: /athanor:work --team mode. waveSize is max parallel workers per wave (limited by Claude Code concurrent Task slots). discoveryRelay=true injects previous wave discoveries into next wave's worker prompts.

memory._doc: Lessons lifecycle in .athanor/lessons/. Working lessons decay after decayDays unless they reach promotionThreshold reads (then auto-promoted to permanent). Sessions older than maxAgeDays are cleaned by the cleaner agent (permanent lessons preserved).

models._doc: DEPRECATED in v0.7.7 — NO skill currently reads this block. The v0.7.6 documentation claimed 'Skills read this config in their dispatch templates' but every skill hardcodes its model: field inline. Schema marks the block deprecated; v0.7.9 will remove it entirely. For customization today, fork the relevant skills/<name>/SKILL.md and edit the inline model: field. (Values kept here historically: planner/critic/executor/reviewer=opus, researcher/analyst/learner=sonnet, cleaner=haiku.)

triggers._doc: Slash-command trigger language: 'ko' (Korean only), 'en' (English only), 'both' (default — both Korean and English keywords trigger skills). See each skill's frontmatter description for trigger keyword lists.

hooks._doc: Stop hook configuration. As of v0.7.8 the Stop hook is registered as `type: command` invoking scripts/hooks/stop_verify_claims.py (per docs/STATE.md §Command-hook Stop blocking spike (2026-05-18)). `profile: "standard"` (default) enables full material-claim detection — the script reads stdin, detects English/Korean claim phrases ported verbatim from the v0.7.7 prompt whitelist, and exits 2 to block Stop with stderr fed back to the model as continuation context. `profile: "off"` is the per-project opt-out: the script exits 0 silently regardless of message content. Unknown profile values fall back to standard with a stderr warning (fail-open). `lenient` and `strict` profiles are not yet supported (deferred per plan §10). The v0.7.7 `hooks.disabled[]` orphan key has been removed in v0.7.8 — no code consumed it. v0.7.9+ adds `stopLoopThreshold` (integer ≥1, default 3): caps consecutive exit-2 blocks per session; the (threshold+1)th invocation releases (exit 0) with a stderr warning, preventing infinite gate loops when the verification skill misbehaves.

review._doc: /athanor:review skill default lenses dispatched in parallel (file-type filtering may narrow this). minConfidence (0-100 anchored rubric) suppresses findings below threshold during consolidation; raise to reduce noise, lower to surface speculative concerns. See agents/reviewer.md §Confidence Rubric.
